items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I did a lot of his early things with him. I mean arranging.

ctx.x: It seems like he absorbed a little bit of Trumbauer and Bix to do something like that, although I think he's great. Hoagy, especially his early stuff. I did a lot of his early things with him. I mean arranging. I particularly liked the way he did "Washboard Blues." I think he's a real American composer; but he -- naturally he got commercial later on, but the way, our business, the way it is, you can't blame a guy for getting commercial. He's going to starve if he doesn't get commercial somehow or other.
Even some of his later hits like "Buttermilk Sky," it had a very good melody.
